original.target_description: Study 1, context-level random-coefficient model predicting continuous music-evoked nostalgia from arousal, controlling the other context predictors.

replication.target_description: Study 1, categorical nostalgia versus control song condition predicting high-arousal ratings; outcome and predictor roles differ from original.

n.sample_role: Participants (clusters); 2,234 song-level observations in the final paired-song analysis.
n.exclusions: 14 removed for improper responses; 172 without appropriately matched control songs excluded. Only complete nostalgia/control song pairs retained.
